cfb.off_ppa.rationale: Raw need is play-level PPA/EPA and success rate (cfb.pbp_cfbd) plus returning-production prior; NEWS 'report separately' and PLAYER_BOX 'snap' and TEAM_BOX 'margin' are incidental keyword hits (margin = garbage-time filter on pbp score), so the NEWS vintage need wrongly forces COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE.

cfb.sp_plus.rationale: Raw data is weekly SP+/FPI/SRS/Elo with capture timestamps; CFBD serves SP+ only as season-level ratings (final-only, revised) and FPI has no archived weekly vintages, so only the Elo/SRS component is computable from results (cfb.games_espn 2021+). SP+/FPI look-ahead makes PIT_COARSE too optimistic.
cfb.sp_plus.notes: keep COMPUTED_PROXY only for the Elo/SRS-from-results part

cfb.talent.rationale: Measurement regresses margin on talent after controlling for efficiency, which needs play-level efficiency from cfb.pbp_cfbd, not only scores in cfb.games_espn (2021+); portal net rating by position group needs the portal dataset.

cfb.rush_efficiency.rationale: Line yards, opportunity rate, stuff rate and highlight yards are computed from play-level rushing yards by down/distance (CFBD advanced stats / pbp); cfb.games_espn holds only scores and box_player has no line-yard fields. Draft status COLLECT_FREE_MEASURED is too optimistic because no mapped dataset supplies play-level data.

cfb.success_explosiveness.rationale: Success rate by down and distance and IsoPPP are play-level (PPA on successful plays) fields from cfb.pbp_cfbd; mapped TEAM_BOX=cfb.games_espn (scores only, 2021+) cannot supply them, so DATA_IN_HAND is wrong.

cfb.pass_efficiency.rationale: PPA per dropback, adjusted yards/attempt, sack and INT rates come from pbp/player stats; charting-based completion over expected is stated as 'where charting exists' (optional), so the SCHEME need on PFF (paid) is spurious and makes it BLOCKED_PAID_ONLY.

cfb.havoc.rationale: Havoc = (TFL+forced fumbles+PBU+INT)/plays needs play/player-level defensive events from cfb.pbp_cfbd; cfb.games_espn has only scores so DATA_IN_HAND is wrong.

cfb.pass_rush.rationale: Adjusted sack rate by standard/passing downs needs play-level data (cfb.pbp_cfbd) and the measurement uses line talent composites and returning starters (recruiting dataset); mapped PLAYER_BOX/TEAM_BOX alone does not cover down-and-distance splits. QB time-to-throw is only a screen-share proxy, so no tracking need.

cfb.ol.rationale: Returning OL starts and snaps need per-player snap counts for linemen, which CFBD/ESPN do not publish (only PFF/SIS: cfb.pff_charting, paid); also needs play-level line yards/sack rates (cfb.pbp_cfbd) and depth-chart changes.

cfb.secondary_coverage.rationale: SCHEME:coverage is a hit on the label word 'coverage'; the measurement is pass success/explosive rate/PPA allowed and PBU rate from pbp, with DB absence (availability) and portal departures. Draft maps nothing to cfb.pbp_cfbd and wrongly flags FINAL_ONLY leakage from a scheme need that does not exist.

cfb.run_defense.rationale: Line yards allowed, stuff rate, rushing PPA allowed are play-level (cfb.pbp_cfbd) but the draft maps no EVENT need (only scores in cfb.games_espn); also needs front-seven talent composite (recruiting) and injury vintages.

cfb.turnover_luck.rationale: Expected turnovers use fumbles, PBU and pass attempts which come from pbp/team stat lines in cfb.pbp_cfbd; mapped cfb.games_espn has only scores. COLLECT_FREE_MEASURED is optimistic.

cfb.qb_rushing.rationale: Designed-run share vs scramble rate and goal-line carries require play-level classification (play text/type) from cfb.pbp_cfbd, not just player box totals; sack accounting also depends on the pbp source.

cfb.td_rates.rationale: Red-zone carries/targets, QB sneak rate and goal-line role are play-level (cfb.pbp_cfbd); mapped TEAM_BOX/PLAYER_BOX totals cannot give them. Team expected TDs 'from total/spread' is a market input that must be replaced by non-market ratings.
cfb.td_rates.notes: expected TDs from spread/total is market-derived; use non-market ratings (depends on cfb.sp_plus)

cfb.dvp.rationale: WEATHER_FCST 'forecast' ('combine with player share to forecast') and DRAFT 'combine' are incidental keyword hits that make the draft COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE; real needs are allowed yards/PPA per target/carry by position from pbp and player positions.

cfb.coaching.rationale: SCHEME:scheme hit on 'scheme tendencies' but the measurement is pace, pass rate, 4th-down and 2-pt rates from pbp (no personnel/formation data), so PFF paid is spurious; the genuine missing need is coach/coordinator history with regime-break dates and previous stops, which no mapped dataset provides.

cfb.pace.rationale: VENUE 'neutral situations' (game-state) and DRAFT 'combine pace of both teams' are incidental keyword hits; the DRAFT need wrongly yields PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY. Real needs are play-level seconds per play/no-huddle rate (cfb.pbp_cfbd) and clock-rule regime by season (rules reference).

cfb.drives.rationale: AVAIL 'available yards' and WEATHER_FCST 'forecast drives' are incidental hits (forecast = projection of drive count), which force COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE; the data needed is drive-level (cfb.pbp_cfbd drives table).

cfb.pass_rate.rationale: WEATHER_FCST 'forecast attempts' and VENUE 'neutral-situation pass rate' are incidental keyword hits (not weather or neutral site); only play-level down/distance/score data (cfb.pbp_cfbd) is needed.
cfb.pass_rate.notes: spread-implied script distribution must come from non-market ratings

cfb.kicker.rationale: Make probability by distance needs FG attempts with distance/result and kicker identity (cfb.pbp_cfbd); the draft maps only WEATHER_OBS. Observed weather is fine for fitting but game-day application needs a forecast.

cfb.redzone.rationale: Red-zone TD% and points per trip are drive/play-level with field position (cfb.pbp_cfbd); draft maps PLAYER_BOX 'points per' (spurious) and game-level data, giving an unjustified COLLECT_FREE_MEASURED.

cfb.q_scoring.rationale: DRAFT 'combine with the game total' and PLAYER_BOX 'share' (period share) are incidental hits; the DRAFT need wrongly gives PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY. Points by quarter are period scores (cfb.games_espn 2021+) and plays by quarter (cfb.pbp_cfbd).

cfb.team_total_split.rationale: Measurement computes implied team means from the spread and total and compares to team-total quotes: it is a market-derived benchmark (mkt.external_odds paid) that the catalog missed.

cfb.officials.rationale: AVAIL 'when assignments are available' is a spurious hit; crew-level penalty data needs crew assignments (no free CFB source, correctly blocked) but the conference-level fallback penalty tendencies need play-level penalties from cfb.pbp_cfbd.
cfb.officials.notes: fallback conference-level penalty tendency is computable from pbp penalties

cfb.standings.rationale: Monte Carlo with rating uncertainty, conference tiebreakers and a committee-based selection model is a simulation: depends on ratings, rating SD and poll/committee behaviour inputs; also needs committee ranking vintages and tiebreaker rules.

cfb.schedule_strength.rationale: Remaining schedule strength sums win probabilities from current ratings with home/rest adjustments: derived from ratings and rest/travel inputs, not a raw TEAM_BOX 'strength' lookup.

cfb.pythag_luck.rationale: Raw data includes PPA by game and an expected record from PPA margin (play-level, cfb.pbp_cfbd, blocked/key) and a k refit on FBS 2005-2025 while cfb.games_espn only covers 2021-2026; COMPUTED_FULL is optimistic.
cfb.pythag_luck.notes: Pythagorean part computable from scores; PPA-based expected record and 2005 refit need CFBD

cfb.award_narrative.rationale: Raw data lists team AP rank by week at ballot dates (poll vintages) and historical winners/finalists; the draft has no POLLS need and TEAM_BOX does not carry weekly AP rank vintages (games_espn ranks are retrieval-time). Measurement also uses an odds path (market).

cfb.futures_coherence.rationale: Raw data is Kalshi bid/ask mids by contract and timestamp; the coherence error is computed solely from market prices (mkt.kalshi_prices), i.e. a market-derived benchmark that the catalog missed. CONTRACTS is spurious (Kalshi contracts, not coach contracts).

cfb.in_game_exit_risk.rationale: Historical snap-share distributions by role require per-player snap counts, which are available only from PFF/SIS (cfb.pff_charting, paid); not in box_player/CFBD.

m.settlement_truth.rationale: Measurement reconciles settled results with an independent box-score source, but no RESULTS/PLAYER_BOX need is mapped; draft only has MARKET_RULES.

m.rules_text.rationale: WEATHER_OBS ('conditions'), EVENT ('overtime') and CONTRACTS ('contract') are incidental hits in the wording of rule text; the only data is Kalshi rules text/versions (mkt.kalshi_rules). The blocked weather host makes the draft COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED unjustifiably.
m.rules_text.notes: rule version history may be truncated for settled series

m.fees.rationale: Fee schedule and maker/taker rules are published Kalshi reference metadata, not a market price series; EXCLUDED_BENCHMARK_ONLY is wrong (RULES/CONTRACTS hits are spurious).

m.lifecycle.rationale: AVAIL 'status' is a spurious hit (market status, not player availability) that produces PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY; open/close/postponement times come from Kalshi market metadata (mkt.kalshi_rules). Halt events may lack history.

m.strike_hit_rates.rationale: PLAYER_BOX 'hit' (hit rate) and CONTRACTS 'contract' are incidental; realized frequency by strike needs Kalshi family/strike metadata plus underlying settled outcomes (results), not coach/finance contracts.

m.stat_source_mismatch.rationale: CONTRACTS 'contract settlement' is a spurious hit (xx.contracts_finance unrelated); needs two stat providers for completed games (ESPN vs CFBD) plus Kalshi settlement-source text.

cfb.season_sim_distribution.rationale: Season Monte Carlo is a simulation built on rating posterior draws, standings/tiebreak logic, committee model and format rules; TEAM_BOX 'total' and NEWS 'report' are incidental hits.

cfb.award_vote_distribution.rationale: Features include team rank (poll vintages) and historical winners/finalists with vote totals; the draft has no POLLS need and TEAM_BOX does not provide weekly AP rank. Prime-time exposure also needs broadcast/kickoff schedule data.

cfb.qb_replacement_value.rationale: Starter/replacement value is EPA per dropback times team dropbacks per game taken from the script inputs: derived from cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts and QB/availability inputs; keep direct needs for pbp passer ids.

cfb.snap_weighted_availability_loss.rationale: Loss formula needs snap_share_i per player per game (raw data 'player snaps by game'), which is only in PFF/SIS (cfb.pff_charting, paid), not box_player/CFBD; also needs timestamped availability vintages.

cfb.rating_posterior_sd.rationale: Bayesian state-space rating prior depends on returning-production shrinkage: derived from cfb.roster_continuity; PLAYER_BOX 'share' is incidental.

cfb.mismatch_cover_curve.rationale: Raw data needs final scores for FBS games since 2014 and a pre-game rating gap (non-market SP+ or own rating); cfb.games_espn covers only 2021-2026 so DATA_IN_HAND is wrong for the 2014+ history (cfb.pbp_cfbd /games from 2001, key needed); the rating gap is derived.

cfb.fourth_down_aggression.rationale: Per-coach go rate requires coach tenure/identity per game and season, which no mapped dataset provides (cfb.coach_history proposed, CFBD /coaches).

cfb.conf_schedule_win_dependence.rationale: Win probabilities come from non-market ratings and rating SD as-of date, with correlated draws: a simulation built on cfb.sp_plus and cfb.rating_posterior_sd; DATA_IN_HAND ignores that cap.

cfb.season_max_total_tail.rationale: LINEUP 'pairing' is a spurious hit that forces COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE; real need is all Division I final scores incl. overtime 2005-2025 (FBS and FCS-vs-FCS), which cfb.games_espn (2021+, FBS-focused) cannot supply: needs NCAA stats-site results.

cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts.rationale: Expected margin comes from non-market ratings (not a quote): derived from cfb.sp_plus; also needs pace/plays inputs.

cfb.completion_yardage_profile.rationale: AVAIL 'where available' (air yards) is a spurious hit forcing COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE; yards per completion and 20+/40+ shares come from pbp (cfb.pbp_cfbd). Depth of target/YAC are not in CFBD plays (only PFF/SIS), so the profile is partial.
cfb.completion_yardage_profile.notes: ADOT/YAC unavailable free; compute yards-based shares only

cfb.expected_possessions.rationale: DRAFT 'combine' (combined drives) is a spurious hit that forces COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE; needs drive durations from the pbp drives table and the clock-rule regime table.

cfb.nonoffensive_scoring_rate.rationale: Raw data is play-type level (interception/fumble/return/blocked-kick TDs) from cfb.pbp_cfbd; mapped TEAM_BOX=cfb.games_espn (scores only, 2021+) cannot identify them, so DATA_IN_HAND is wrong.

cfb.stadium_wind_exposure.rationale: Fit uses forecast at issue 6h out vs observed wind over 8 seasons, but the forecast archive (env.weather_forecast_pit) only reconstructs from ~2022, so history is ~4 seasons and the forecasts are reconstructions: PIT_SAFE is optimistic.

cfb.regulation_tie_curve.rationale: Fit on all FBS games since 2005 (~15,000) with expected margin from SP+ or own rating (not market): needs period scores back to 2005 (cfb.pbp_cfbd /games, not games_espn 2021+) and is derived from the rating input.

cfb.two_point_shootout_rate.rationale: SCHEME 'play type' is a spurious hit (PFF paid): two-point attempts with result and play type and goal-to-go plays are in pbp (cfb.pbp_cfbd).

cfb.season_ot_exposure.rationale: Per-game q_K uses P(tie after 60) from cfb.regulation_tie_curve and OT continuation: derived simulation input.

cfb.period_margin_lattice.rationale: Needs line scores for FBS games since 2014 and non-market expected margin/total (derived from rating); cfb.games_espn only has 2021+.

cfb.second_half_ot_spillover.rationale: P(OT) comes from the tie curve and OT margin distribution: derived from cfb.regulation_tie_curve.

cfb.quarter_joint_scoring_pmf.rationale: Scoring-drive count mean comes from cfb.q_scoring times expected possessions and expected total/margin from non-market ratings: derived; line scores from 2014 need CFBD, not games_espn.

cfb.half_tie_conditional_win.rationale: Fit on FBS games since 2014 with non-market expected margin/total: derived from rating; history before 2021 needs cfb.pbp_cfbd /games.

cfb.period_share_of_total.rationale: Shares by non-market expected total/gap bins since 2014: derived from rating; line scores history needs CFBD (games_espn is 2021+). PLAYER_BOX 'share' is spurious.

cfb.period_drive_clock_budget.rationale: DRAFT 'combine' ('combined drives') is a spurious hit forcing COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE; needs drive start/end clock by period (cfb.pbp_cfbd) and the clock-rule regime.

cfb.second_half_ot_total_increment.rationale: P(OT) from cfb.ot_model using non-market expected margin/total, fitted on FBS games from 2005: derived; history needs cfb.pbp_cfbd, not games_espn.

cfb.team_period_points_share.rationale: Expected points come from opponent-adjusted off_ppa/def_ppa and the period share of total: derived from cfb.off_ppa, cfb.def_ppa, cfb.period_share_of_total; PLAYER_BOX 'receiver' is the kickoff receiver (pbp), spurious.

cfb.remaining_game_win_probabilities.rationale: Win probability vector is margin = rating diff + site effect with SD: derived from ratings and rest/travel inputs; also needs the schedule with sites.

cfb.rating_posterior_draws.rationale: Bayesian rating prior uses last-season rating and returning-production shrinkage: derived from cfb.roster_continuity; results from games_espn only cover 2021+.

cfb.cfp_committee_resume_model.rationale: Raw data needs point-in-time starting-QB availability by game (injury/depth-chart vintages), committee rankings per release, ESPN Strength of Record vintages (not archived) or an own resume metric; PLAYER_BOX 'quarterback' and EVENT 'quarter' are spurious. Derived from rating and QB-status inputs.

cfb.program_trajectory_index.rationale: Regression uses 3-year recruiting composite, portal net rating, new head coach flag (coach history) and annual ratings: derived from cfb.talent and cfb.sp_plus; coach-change flag has no mapped dataset.

cfb.qb_availability_hazard.rationale: Hazard multiplier uses designed rushing rates: derived from cfb.qb_rushing; EVENT 'quarter' (quarterback) is spurious.

cfb.bowl_selection_state.rationale: Raw data needs opponent division per game and FCS two-year average football grants-in-aid (90% threshold) or NCAA waiver decisions, which no registry dataset holds; simulation draws come from cfb.rating_posterior_draws. AVAIL 'status' is spurious.

cfb.lower_division_title_model.rationale: Needs FCS, D3 and Ivy game results and FCS bracket/seeds by season: cfb.games_espn/pbp_cfbd are FBS-focused; rating comes from cfb.lower_division_game_margin_model.

cfb.lower_division_game_margin_model.rationale: Needs Division III and FCS final scores with division, neutral flag, playoff round/seed since 2010; cfb.games_espn (FBS, 2021+) and CFBD do not cover D3 or most FCS-vs-FCS games.

cfb.own_drive_share.rationale: DRAFT 'combine' ('combined possessions') is a spurious hit forcing COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE; needs the pbp drives table with clock and turnovers.

cfb.team_pair_score_covariance.rationale: Residual correlation uses FBS games since 2014 and pre-game non-market expected points (derived from rating); cfb.games_espn covers 2021+ only so DATA_IN_HAND overstates history.

cfb.first_td_race_rate.rationale: Hazard depends on team TD per trip, drive pace and opening possession order: derived from cfb.td_per_scoring_trip, cfb.expected_possessions, cfb.period_possession_allocation.

cfb.dst_td_propensity.rationale: Raw data is play-level interception/fumble/return/blocked-kick TD flags (cfb.pbp_cfbd), absent from the draft; PLAYER_BOX 'prop' is a spurious hit.

cfb.td_count_dispersion.rationale: TDs by game/team/type FBS 2014+ come from scoring plays (cfb.pbp_cfbd), not scores in games_espn (2021+); expected total/gap bins are non-market ratings (derived).

cfb.award_vote_feature_model.rationale: Raw data needs team record and AP rank at ballot date (poll vintages) and prior-year honours; the draft has no POLLS need.

cfb.coach_overperformance_index.rationale: Raw data needs preseason non-market ratings vintage, AP rank history, conference title flags and coach-of-year winners: needs POLLS/AWARDS/coach history, and a derived preseason rating; DATA_IN_HAND on games_espn alone is optimistic.

cfb.defender_production_profile.rationale: Pressures and pass-rush snaps are PFF/SIS fields (cfb.pff_charting, paid), not in CFBD/ESPN; mapped box_player gives only sacks/TFL.

cfb.coach_exit_hazard_features.rationale: VENUE 'venue' (matches 'revenue') and EVENT 'hazard' are spurious; needs head-coach tenure/exit events with dates and cause (cfb.coach_history), contract terms and athletic revenue (EADA).

cfb.coach_buyout_exposure.rationale: VENUE hit comes from 'revenue'; contract amendments with dates are not preserved as vintages (xx.contracts_finance), so PIT_SAFE is optimistic.

cfb.governance_vote_count_state.rationale: AWARDS 'voting' is a spurious hit (governance votes, not award ballots); needs dated stakeholder statements (timestamped news, prospective) and governing-document thresholds (rules).

cfb.transfer_destination_candidate_model.rationale: Raw data includes a reported-interest timeline (timestamped news), absent from the draft needs.

cfb.realignment_feasibility_state.rationale: Raw data includes membership votes and reported talks with dates (timestamped news, no free archive); draft only maps CONTRACTS and calls it COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED/PIT_SAFE.

cfb.ballot_points_gap.rationale: AWARDS 'voter' is a spurious hit (AP poll voters); only weekly AP points/first-place votes by release (rankings_polls) are needed.

cfb.top_team_loss_hazard.rationale: Succession simulation uses ratings by week and per-game win probabilities: derived from cfb.sp_plus and cfb.remaining_game_win_probabilities; EVENT 'hazard' is spurious.

cfb.cfp_ranking_resume_features.rationale: Alias of cfb.cfp_committee_resume_model; needs injury status vintages and committee rankings, so inherits its upstream status.

cfb.title_path_to_final_ap.rationale: Raw data needs historical AP final rank vs CFP champion, projected CFP seeds and rating SD: derived from cfb.rating_posterior_draws, cfb.season_sim_distribution and committee model; DATA_IN_HAND is wrong.

cfb.opp_dropback_volume.rationale: Alias of cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts; SCHEME 'play type' is spurious (PFF paid) since plays with down/distance/score/type come from pbp.

cfb.net_yards_per_play_model.rationale: Expected plays and pass share come from pace and script inputs and rush/pass efficiency: derived from cfb.pace, cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts, cfb.rush_efficiency, cfb.pass_efficiency.

cfb.victory_formation_yardage.rationale: SCHEME 'formation' is a hit on 'victory formation'; kneels are classified from pbp play text (cfb.pbp_cfbd), so PFF paid is spurious.

cfb.g6_cfp_berth_count_model.rationale: Simulation using shared rating draws, committee model, membership map and format rules: derived from cfb.rating_posterior_draws, cfb.cfp_committee_resume_model, cfb.conference_membership_and_schedule_map, cfb.playoff_format.

cfb.joint_path_event_model.rationale: Shared season simulation with tiebreaker logic, committee selection and bracket rules: derived from cfb.rating_posterior_draws, cfb.conference_membership_and_schedule_map, cfb.cfp_committee_resume_model, cfb.playoff_format.

cfb.half_to_full_transition_matrix.rationale: Needs FBS quarter line scores since 2014 (cfb.pbp_cfbd, not games_espn 2021+), second-half kickoff receiver (pbp), and non-market rating vintages (derived).

cfb.halftime_adjustment_differential.rationale: Raw data needs coach and coordinator history; CFBD has head coaches only and coordinators need manual coding, none mapped in the draft.

cfb.cross_game_residual_dependence.rationale: Uses own rating posterior draws with conference offsets: derived from cfb.rating_posterior_draws and cfb.cross_conf_calibration; PLAYER_BOX 'share' is spurious.

cfb.margin_total_joint_pmf.rationale: Needs FBS 2014+ results (CFBD), own expected margin/total vintages (derived) and drive data; CONTRACTS 'contract strikes' is Kalshi (MARKET_RULES), not coach contracts.

cfb.counting_stat_tie_mass.rationale: Computed from the joint end-of-season simulation: derived from cfb.stat_leader_field_simulation; historical leaderboards for FCS need NCAA stats.

cfb.stat_leader_field_simulation.rationale: Field includes FCS players (stats.ncaa.org) for Division I leader contracts; cfb.box_player is FBS ESPN only; simulation builds on leader race state and stat variance inputs.

cfb.weather_delay_hazard.rationale: AVAIL 'status' and TEAM_BOX 'record' are spurious; historical delay records (raw data) have no dataset (scoreboard has no delay log), needs a manual delay-record set plus thunderstorm forecast and lightning data.

cfb.script_rush_attempts.rationale: Rush attempts count sacks/kneels as rushes and use neutral-situation run share plus lead effect: derived from cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts.

cfb.fg_attempt_make_model.rationale: Depends on coach 4th-down decisions in range (derived from fourth-down aggression) and kicker make model.

cfb.leader_race_state.rationale: Uses team scoring expectation and remaining opponents' allowed rates: derived from cfb.player_stat_variance-style inputs and team script; FBS-only player logs.

new_datasets.title: Head-coach tenure, hire/exit dates and records by program (CFBD /coaches, Wikipedia)
new_datasets.missingness: head coaches only; interim periods and exit cause need manual coding

new_datasets.title: Offensive/defensive coordinator history by season and game
new_datasets.missingness: no free structured coordinator archive; hand-coded from staff pages

new_datasets.title: NCAA stats-site results and player/team stats for FBS, FCS, D2 and D3
new_datasets.missingness: unprobed; scrape terms and coverage by division unverified

new_datasets.title: FCS football grants-in-aid and NCAA bowl-eligibility waiver decisions
new_datasets.missingness: not in any structured free feed; manual encoding

new_datasets.title: Historical weather-delay incidents by game
new_datasets.missingness: no delay field in the ESPN scoreboard archive; hand-collected from game notes

registry_objections.objection: Mapped as TEAM_BOX for efficiency/PPA/havoc/line-yard quantities, but its title and missingness note show only scores, period scores, venue, ranks (retrieval-time) and 2021-2026 history; it cannot supply play-level team stats or 2005/2014+ histories required by many inputs.
Used for OFFICIALS need (rules.py M['CFB']['OFFICIALS']) although it is a tracking/scheme dataset; crew assignments are a separate data class with no registry entry.
